$comment: Curated CC0 sources. 'scope' = 'whole-library' when every item at the source is CC0; 'filter-only' when the source mixes licenses and only items carrying a CC0 label qualify. 'searchable' = this repo's MCP server can search it directly. 'verified' = date and evidence this entry was last checked against the source's own license page or API. 'pending' = candidates not yet verified; they are neither recommended nor known to be non-CC0.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.notes: API requires a User-Agent naming your app and a 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit when showing live API content. Downloaded assets need no attribution.
